Lessons.Title: Large Numbers on a Number Line
ExplanationParagraphs:
Learning goal: You will use place value understanding to locate large numbers on a number line and describe number relationships in which one multi-digit number is ten times as much as another.
In this lesson, you both estimate and precisely locate numbers through the hundred-thousands place on a number line. This lesson is designed to deepen your understanding of the relative position of multi-digit numbers to multiples of 100, 1,000, 10,000, and 100,000. You learn that when numbers are related by ten times as much, you are located in a position on a number line with the same relationship to surrounding benchmark numbers.
Core relationship: Uniformly scaled number lines. Check both endpoints and tick interval: each tenfold increase changes the coordinate by a factor of ten.

Local publisher 2021 source lesson activities: Warm-up:  Estimation Exploration: What Number Could This Be?	 (10 minutes); Activity 1:  Locate Large Numbers	 (20 minutes); Activity 2:  So Many Numbers, So Little Line	 (15 minutes); Cool-down:  Ten Times on a Number Line	 (5 minutes)
Source-aligned Edulytics model: What is 100 times 3,470?
First-party Cool-down (not gated original): A number line is labelled 0, 10,000, 20,000; where is 15,000?
Original visual/physical and peer-explanation activities still require teacher review.
